newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil cuts Canada oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil cuts Canada oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$9.00/cubic metre or C$1.43/barrel, effective immediately.

The new prices were listed as follows: Edmonton light sweet C$209.00/cubic metre, or C$33.23/barrel Cromer light sour C$202.00/cubic metre, or C$32.12/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$169.00/cubic metre, or C$26.87/barrel Midale at Cromer C$177.00/cubic metre, or C$28.14/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
